I'm missing a bound invariant on the loop variable, so the precondition for the sum function call inside the invariant isn't guaranteed to hold, which breaks preservation; I also need to tie the exit condition to ind == i-1 to bridge to the postcondition.

The fix is to add "i - 1 <= ind < j" as an invariant, placed before the existing one, which keeps the sum call well-formed (ind+1 stays within bounds) and lets the arithmetic step through correctly since sum(a,i,ind+1) decomposes into a[ind] plus sum(a,i,ind) when ind+1 > i.
